messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking staged rollout v4.0.0 -> 6% (eu-west-3, us-west-2). Change window 02:30-04:30 UTC. Health checks: 15m error-rate + p99 latency. Release notes: <internal/release/4.0.0>

claire: Noticing a small rise in 502s in eu-west-3 after ~4m. Sample traces show upstream timeouts from payments-proxy.

samir: I see elevated p95 on the payments cache in that region. Could be cache miss storm due to sharding change in this release.

alex: We changed cache shard key to include tenant-id to avoid cross-tenant collisions. Might be increasing hotspotting for large tenants.

claire: Proposal: PAUSE further percent ramps, pin eu-west-3 to v3.9.8 while we validate hotspot mitigation (rate-limit heavy tenants and add a shard fallback). Avoid global rollback if us-west-2 stays healthy.

oncall-bot: @samir, @alex 1: oncall is samir. Pager notified.

samir: Oncall ack. I'll run the pause & pin if we agree. Commands: `deployctl rollout pause --version=4.0.0 --strategy=percent` and `deployctl pin --version=3.9.8 --routes=eu-west-3 --reason="payments cache hotspot"`.

alex: Also opening hotfix PR to add tenant-level backoff and a fallback to old sharding for affected tenants. ETA ~25m.

claire: Approve pause & pin. Execute now.

samir: Running commands. exec-id: exec-20260325-101.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by samir (exec-20260325-101). No further percent increases will be applied.

deploy-bot: Pins applied: eu-west-3 -> v3.9.8.

claire: Pin confirmed. Creating incident INC-20260325-11 and assigning alex for hotfix.

alex: Hotfix PR opened: payments-cache#512. Will run staging smoke and a targeted load test for large tenants.

samir: Monitoring: eu-west-3 502s trending down post-pin. If staging hotfix validates, plan to unpin, introduce a 2% canary with fallback enabled, and monitor 15m before resuming.

claire: Decision summary: STOP ramp. Pin region to stable. Hotfix + staging validation required. Reintroduce cautiously with tenant backoff and fallback.

deploy-bot: Thread paused for follow-up. Reopen or @samir for GO when ready.
